question: Which part of the plant allows for the uptake of carbon dioxide and limits the loss of water due to evaporation?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Stomata.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The stomata** part of the plant allows for the uptake of carbon dioxide and limits the loss of water due to evaporation.
 
• The stomata present in the leaves are responsible for the uptake of carbon dioxide and limit the loss of water due to evaporation.
